route_title: 20-Layer Asymmetric FP with Fixed ±10 nm Perturbation Bounds
compilation_rationale: Compiled 20-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 asymmetric Fabry-Perot filter with ±10 nm absolute thickness bounds. Optimization enforces ≥95% transmission at 1550 nm and ≤5% transmission across 1400–1500 nm and 1600–1700 nm via mean and worst-case aggregation. Coherent smatrix solver applied with gradient-based Adam-LBFGS optimizer.
